assay: total RNA-seq (Takara SMARTer Pico v3) of plasma exosome RNA, NovaSeq X Plus (S2.13.p1, S2.14.p1)
sample_inclusion: Cohort 2 only (non-PD, age-matched rats): exercise treatment then exosome molecular biology (S2.1.p1, ABS.p1); n = 4 per group (S2.5.p1); S4.4.p1 states 5 per group (discrepancy). Cohort 1 (PFF histology) has no sequencing.

group: Exercise (1 month treadmill, 20 m/min, 30 min, 5 d/wk)

primary_estimand: Difference in plasma exosomal RNA abundance, exercised vs sedentary non-PD rats, blood drawn within 30 min of last exercise (S2.4.p1, S3.4.p1)
planned_contrasts: Exercise vs Sedentary (S2.5.p1, S3.4.p1; paper: 27 RNAs upregulated, Table 2; no downregulated list reported)
normalization: CLC Genomics Workbench v25 TPM (GEO data_processing); paper does not describe the DE normalization
paper_method: not_reported (GEO data_processing names CLC Genomics Workbench v25.0; the DE test is not named in the paper)

paper_threshold.note: No rule stated. Table 2 lists only upregulated RNAs with raw P-values 3.76E-04 to 0.05 and FC 3.09 to 142.31 (S3.4.p1: 'fold change ranging from 3 to 142'); implied rule raw P <= 0.05 and FC >= 3, up only.
